messages:
mira (eng-platform): quick flag: Unit Cost panel shows "estimated cache credits" > billed for some routes after last night's routing change. getting negative amortized cost in sparkline.

sam (frontend): can you paste an example route id? i can clamp visuals quickly.

mira (eng-platform): route=payments/intent-create, model=redwood-xlarge. screenshot: https://img.redwood/unitcost-odd.png

ellie (data): likely sampling + fallback routing mismatch. our sampler leaves out prefetch-only events so tokens_saved_est is undercounted when scaled; when we subtract we end up negative. need provenance.

ian (infra): quick fix: we can emit two internal telemetry keys from proxy: `cache_contrib_est` and `prefetch_tokens`. non-breaking. consumer can use cache_contrib_est when present.

nina (billing): billing export must never show negative dollar amounts. please clamp in CSVs and mark rows with `confidence=low` when provenance missing.

sam (frontend): plan: 1) clamp displayed value to 0 in summary views (fast) 2) show uncertainty band + confidence chip in detailed row when `cache_confidence != high` (next-week).

ellie (data): followup: i'll run a targeted 72h full-scan for routes that show negative values and produce a before/after table (sample_est vs full_count). will post results in ENGPLAT-7299.

ian (infra): i'll add feature-flag `emit_cache_provenance=false` -> roll to true canary. low effort ~3h.

uxbot: automated note  Scheduling suppression of cost alerts for affected tenant set during full-scan window.

mira (eng-platform): consensus: clamp immediately, schedule provenance headers + consumer migration, run backfill on flagged routes, and surface confidence in UI. i'll open ENGPLAT-7299 and assign tasks. thanks all.
